serverInfo.title: cabuya.org site tools
serverInfo.description: The two public tools of cabuya.org over MCP: validate a published Cabuya manifest or feed (conformance is measured, never declared — this is the measurement), and read any page of the site as Markdown. This is the site server, not the network-level federation server, which is specified and not deployed.
